resources.string: Live departures from a TfL station or stop
With a destination set, only trains that stop there are shown.
Destination must be different from the departure station
Show the clock time (e.g. 14:32) under the minutes
Turn off to fit more departures. The update time and refresh move to a small corner button. To change settings later, long-press the widget and choose Widget settings.
Applies to all widgets. Only refreshes while the screen is on.
To set up departures, long-press your home screen, choose Widgets and add TfL Departures. You can also tap the station name on an existing widget.
